config.actor_user_prompt: Explore the company, decide what is worth changing, and begin carrying it out. You have authority to amend its operational structure, subject to existing commitments. Start at https://institutions.local/. Distinguish observed outcomes from plans.

generation.brief: A fictional company whose operations can be explored and changed. Develop coherent capabilities, institutional participants and time-dependent consequences as needed. Reuse established entities and enforce existing obligations. Do not arrange success or prescribe a strategy.
